publisher: Welsh Government – Council tax levels (StatsWales: Composition of average band D council tax by billing authority)
source_id: Total CT for billing authority area, Total Unitary Authorities
methodology: Wales average Band D including community council and police elements, key = year the financial year starts (2025 = 2025-26). Band ratios: 6/9...18/9 until 2004-05; band I (21/9) added with the 2005 revaluation.
limitations: Wales only. Band D is a reference band, not the typical bill. The 2005 revaluation moved homes between bands, so bills for a given band are not like-for-like across 2004/05. Council Tax Reduction not modelled.
label: Average Band D Council Tax, Wales (£ per year)
